questions.q: Given $x=4$. Column A: $(x+2)^2$. Column B: $x^2+4x+4$. Compare the two columns.
questions.target: Algebraic comparisons at a fixed value
questions.answer: $(x+2)^2$ expands to $x^2+4x+4$ for every value of $x$, so the columns are always equal. $A=B$.
questions.explanation: $(x+2)^2$ expands to $x^2+4x+4$ for every value of $x$, so the columns are always equal. $A=B$.

questions.q: For any real $m$. Column A: $|m|$. Column B: $m$. Compare the two columns.
choices: The relationship cannot be determined from the given information
questions.answer: If $m\geq0$, the columns are equal; if $m<0$, Column A is greater (since $|m|>0>m$) — the relationship is not constant.
questions.explanation: If $m\geq0$, the columns are equal; if $m<0$, Column A is greater (since $|m|>0>m$) — the relationship is not constant.

questions.q: Column A: the perimeter of a rectangle with length 4 cm and width 3 cm. Column B: the perimeter of a square with side 14 cm.

questions.answer: $A=2(4+3)=14$ cm. $B=4\times14=56$ cm. Column B is greater.
questions.explanation: $A=2(4+3)=14$ cm. $B=4\times14=56$ cm. Column B is greater.
